---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Summary

A short description of the feature you would like.

## Motivation

Why would this be useful? Which problem does it solve?

## Proposed solution

If you have a concrete idea, describe it. Feel free to include a sketch or
example usage.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider, and why are they less suitable?

## Additional context

Screenshots, references, or other context that helps explain the request.
